scope: Knight combat, target presentation and representative quest repair
changes: Hand-fitted heater shield with rear grip; sword hilt moved into the palm and open hand silhouette closed.
Thirteen baked Knight clips, blended locomotion and server-timed action contact/recovery. Paused animation sampling prevents frame-zero resets.
Movement and evade cancel windups; cancelled actions do not commit damage, cost or cooldown. Unlawful aggression still turns the player red.
Confirmed resolve/hit events drive sword trails, contact sparks, shield impact, challenge, interpose, Rally and Last Oath cues with distance-based synthesized sound.
Enemy retreat has explicit state and facing; target frame and nameplate eligibility reject retreating, dead, distant, occluded or offscreen actors.
Mara gives a specific reason and route, the memorial supplies named evidence, and the return concludes the local task with one reward.
